sentences: Vlog只记录自己的生活，别人是不爱看的。
Vlogs that only record your own life—people don't watch them.
nobody watches（没人爱看）
保持素材不变，只去调整Vlog的结构，就能够迅速高效地让你的数据翻倍。
Keep footage, restructure the vlog, and quickly double your numbers.
restructure only（只调结构）
把新闻价值大的内容放在最前面。

inverted pyramid（倒金字塔）
scenes.speak: Vlogs that only record your own life—people don't watch them. Keep footage, restructure the vlog, and quickly double your numbers. Put the most newsworthy content first.

scenes.context: 平平无奇的开头换成先给结果。
sentences: Vlog的拍摄是基于一个又一个单独的事件的。
Vlogs are shot as a series of separate events.
separate events（独立事件）
这样的讲法就很平平无奇，很难引起观众的兴趣。
This plain telling fails to grab audience interest.
plain telling（平平无奇）
倒金字塔的做法就是先给我最爽的结果，然后再去描述过程。
The inverted pyramid shows the best result first, then the process.
result first（先给结果）
scenes.speak: Vlogs are shot as a series of separate events. This plain telling fails to grab audience interest. The inverted pyramid shows the best result first, then the process.

sentences: 第一句要给它改成：最近我只用了一周时间，就成功地减掉了两斤。
Change the first line: 'This week alone I lost two pounds.'
lead with result（先讲结果）
我靠的不是什么自律，我靠的是热爱。
Not by discipline, but by passion.
by passion（靠热爱）

Step two: show more detail and process.
details and process（细节过程）

sentences: 第三步是去体验你的方法、情绪或者价值观。
Step three: convey your method, emotion, or values.
emotion and values（情绪价值观）
跟开头的这个原版相比较一下，你会发现有非常大的差异。

huge difference（巨大差异）
赶紧用这个方法回去把你的Vlog重组一下。
Go restructure your vlog with this method.

scenes.speak: Step three: convey your method, emotion, or values. Compare with the original and you'll see a huge difference. Go restructure your vlog with this method.

practice: Put the most newsworthy content first.
Plain event-telling fails to grab interest.
Lead with the most satisfying result.
pitfalls: Record daily life and expect views.
Lead with the best result, then process.
Reveal the payoff at the end.
Add passion and achievement to the process.
Compare to see the huge difference.
shifts: 用 inverted pyramid（倒金字塔）、front-load the result（结果前置）、most newsworthy（最有新闻价值）
用 the satisfying result（最爽结果）、plain telling（平平无奇）、hook（钩子）
用 reassemble footage（重组素材）、separate events（独立事件）、universal formula（万能公式）
